response.original_title: The Pilbara - Land of Rustic Images
response.overview: Explore the magic and mystery of Australia's most primitive landmass on a spectacular journey to Western Australia's remote Pilbara region.  From the untamed beauty of rugged gorges like Joffre, Knox, Kalamina, Dales, and Weano in the Karijini National Park, to the refreshing waters of the tropical oases in Millstream Chichester National Park, this is a voyage into the heart of nature.  At Newman, see the incredible excavations at BHP's massive Mount Whaleback Mine. Explore the mineral boom towns of Port Hedland, its magnificent harbour and Karratha, coastal gateway to the North West.  Discover the famed Burrup Peninsula, its secluded sandy beaches and site of ancient Aboriginal rock carvings.  Experience eerie remnants of The Pilbara's most famous ghost town, Cossack, once a thriving base for pearl diving.  Visit Australia's hottest town, the legendary Marble Bar, Coongan River, Fortescue River, Fortescue Falls, Old Comet Gold Mine, and the mighty Hammersley Range.
